primitives.name: Official NFL Injury Status Mapping
primitives.verbatim_quote: `nfl-com` (8 Capabilities — Official `api.nfl.com` — `5 credits/call`) - `nfl-com/sports-league-data/injury_report`: Official NFL weekly practice participation (`FULL`/`LIMITED`/`DIDNOT`), primary injury, and game designation (`OUT`/`DOUBTFUL`/`QUESTIONABLE`).

primitives.breakdown_regime: Operates within NFL's closed-system classification; fails when external sources introduce different terminology.

primitives.name: Fantasy Projection Uncertainty Quantification
primitives.verbatim_quote: es — `5 credits/call`) - `draftsharks-com/fantasy-sports-rankings/weekly_rankings`: Weekly positional rankings (`QB`, `RB`, `WR`, `TE`, `FLX`, `DST`, `ALL`) in `STD`, `HALF`, `PPR`, or `TEP` with `projected_points` (median), `projected_floor`, `projected_ceiling`, `consensus_points`, `tier`, `opponent`, and `strength_of_schedule`.

primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down under extreme volatility events (e.g., bye weeks, injuries).
